note: Large USACE campground on the White River arm of Table Rock Lake south of Shell Knob. Of the paved lakeside sites, 28-30 and 37-44 face the boat-ramp cove: site 28's pad sits at the riprap edge, and sites 39-43 have an open lawn down to the water. The day-use beach and marina are at the north and south ends. The gravel west loop (sites 50-75) is wooded. --Claude
summary: Confirmed from rec.gov: 71 overnight sites (stored 76 = the description's count), 50-amp at 42 / 30-amp at 21, water at 41, no sewer; $16-$28 (stored high $25 -> $28); season Apr 1 - Oct 30 written; 3-night holiday minimum. Lakefront kept on site 28 (pad at the riprap, ~15-20 m to high water, open apron) and 39-43 (~40-45 m open lawn to the cove); beach and marina are day use. Phone 417-858-3903 to add; pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront, kept). Site-level read; distances are from the 0.22 m/px leaf-off frame of the east cove beside the boat ramp, cross-checked with the rec.gov site photos. Site 28: the pad head sits at the riprap line, ~15-20 m from the high-water edge, with grass and a few shrubs and no road between (the loop road runs behind the pad). Its rec.gov photo shows open water directly past the pad, so lakefront is earned. Sites 39, 41 and 43: pad ends line a rock border, with ~40-45 m of open lawn and scattered trees down to the cove. That's within the ~50 m bound, and the 41 photo shows grass to the water, so it's an open apron. Site 44: the photo shows the ramp lot/apron between the pad and the water on one side, so it's borderline. Site 30: trees, ~30 m, a view at most. Sites 22-27: the shore road lies between them and the water, so they're not on-water. The west loop (50-75) is wooded, ~200 m+ inland. The sandy beach (north end, swim buoys) and the marina (south end) are day use and earn nothing. The value rests on 28 and 39-43 at the cove. If AWH treats the cove lawn as the ramp's used day-use ground, it rests on 28 alone.
PHONE: rec.gov lists 417-858-3903; the entry has no phone. apply.py doesn't write it, so add it by hand.

PIN: stored 36.5958,-93.5503 is the rec.gov facility point (36.5958333,-93.5502778). It already falls inside the campground, on the south loop beside site 15, so no move is needed. Optional: the site centroid is 36.5968,-93.5515.

SITE COUNT: stored 76 matches the facility description ('76 reservable campsites'). The current catalog has 71 overnight sites (62 electric + 9 nonelectric) plus a day-use group shelter, so 71 is written.
